games.name: Unseen Liminality
games.desc:
This is an Exploration Game. Explore and venture what is remembered in the endless hallways of this liminal setting and discover what lies behind the walls and possibly what lurks in the shadows.
"The more times it remembers something, the less it does."

Play on max graphics for the best experience.
Controls:
Q - settings
C - Crouch
Left Shift - Sprint
V - Zoom
CTRL - Mouse lock

Inspired by:
Popular Liminal Images
Beyond Liminal
Backrooms by Kane Pixels
Oldest View by Kane Pixels

Special Thanks to @angiealic for mall assets
